meaning.en: then the great Lord Brahma spoke
meaning.hi: तब महान ब्रह्मा जी ने कहा

meaning.en: an Upanishad centered on direct, first-hand realization
meaning.hi: प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव पर केंद्रित उपनिषद्

meaning.en: I will explain, I will teach

meaning.en: the deepest of deep secrets
meaning.hi: गूढ़ों में परम गूढ़

meaning.en: not to be taught to the unready, ordinary listener
meaning.hi: अयोग्य को न सिखाई जाए

meaning.en: to the calm, inward-turned, truly attentive listener
meaning.hi: शांत, अंतर्मुखी, श्रवणशील को

meaning.en: of worldly bondage and liberation

meaning.en: knowledge and ignorance, the two eyes

meaning.en: ignorance is the eye that sees only darkness

meaning.en: up to Brahma and down to unmoving things
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा से स्थावर तक

meaning.en: endless, covering every created being without exception

meaning.en: the ordinary world of desire-driven action taught in scripture
meaning.hi: शास्त्रोक्त सकाम-कर्म का संसार

meaning.en: this darkness is not the true self
meaning.hi: यह अंधकार आत्मा नहीं है

meaning.en: true knowledge is like a second sun in the realm of understanding
meaning.hi: विद्या मानो ज्ञानखंड में सूर्य के समान है

meaning.en: it shows only the sphere of light, nothing else

meaning.en: carried in the silent mantra of the breath, 'so-ham', I am That
meaning.hi: अजपा मंत्र 'सोऽहम्' में निहित

meaning.en: through the breath moving in and out, forward and back
meaning.hi: प्राण-अपान की अनुलोम-विलोम गति से

meaning.en: coming to perceive it this way
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार अनुभव करके

meaning.en: having held this steadily for a long time
meaning.hi: इसे लंबे समय तक स्थिर रखकर

meaning.en: when the threefold self contemplates Brahman deeply
meaning.hi: त्रिगुणात्मक आत्मा के ब्रह्म-ध्यान में

meaning.en: the Supreme Self, existence-consciousness-bliss, reveals itself
meaning.hi: सच्चिदानंद परमात्मा प्रकट होता है

meaning.en: filled and radiant with the light of a thousand suns
meaning.hi: हज़ार सूर्यों की चमक से भरा

meaning.en: untouched, like the ocean full from shore to shore
meaning.hi: अछूता, समुद्र की पूर्णता समान

meaning.en: this is not mere meditative absorption
meaning.hi: यह समाधि नहीं है

meaning.en: this is not a yogic power or perfection
meaning.hi: यह योगसिद्धि नहीं है

meaning.en: this is not simply the mind dissolving
meaning.hi: यह मनोलय नहीं है

meaning.en: it is oneness with Brahman itself

meaning.en: colored like the sun, standing beyond darkness
meaning.hi: सूर्य-वर्ण, अंधकार से परे

meaning.en: the steady, wise one perceives every form
meaning.hi: धीर पुरुष सभी रूपों को देखता है

meaning.en: having named them, he then rests beyond it all
meaning.hi: नामकरण कर, वह उससे परे रहता है

meaning.en: the Creator brought this forth at the very beginning
meaning.hi: स्रष्टा ने इसे आरंभ में प्रकट किया

meaning.en: Indra, having understood it, spread it in the four directions

words.sanskrit: tam eva vidvan amritah iha bhavati

meaning.en: whoever knows this becomes immortal, right here
meaning.hi: जो इसे जानता है वह यहीं अमर होता है

meaning.en: there is no other road to that freedom
meaning.hi: मुक्ति का कोई अन्य मार्ग नहीं

meaning.en: the gods worshipped sacrifice itself through sacrifice
meaning.hi: देवों ने यज्ञ से यज्ञ की उपासना की

meaning.en: these were the very first sacred acts

meaning.en: where the ancient gods themselves dwell
meaning.hi: जहाँ प्राचीन देवता निवास करते हैं

meaning.en: I am that sun, the light beyond all light
meaning.hi: मैं वही सूर्य, परम ज्योति हूँ

meaning.en: I am the sun's own brightness, I am Shiva

meaning.en: I am the light of the self, the purest brightness
meaning.hi: मैं आत्मा का प्रकाश, शुद्धतम ज्योति हूँ

meaning.en: the source from which every other light shines
meaning.hi: सब प्रकाशों का मूल स्रोत

meaning.en: whoever studies this Atharvashira teaching
meaning.hi: जो यह अथर्वशिरः पढ़ता है

meaning.en: reciting it in the morning burns away the night's wrongdoing

meaning.hi: संध्या और प्रातः दोनों समय अभ्यास करने वाला

meaning.en: reciting it at midday, facing the sun

meaning.en: is freed from the five great wrongs and their lesser forms
meaning.hi: पंच महापाप और उपपापों से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: gains the merit of studying every Veda in full

meaning.en: thus ends this Upanishad
